tips.text: Buy the blueprint, do one Mars session for Morphics and Salvage, then Ceres for Circuits and Saturn or Uranus for Plastids.
Fold the Morphics farm into other Mars runs, such as a Mars Void Fissure, instead of farming it alone.
Farm in regular missions with a loot frame and a Resource Booster; boosters skip bounty and end-of-mission rewards.
Treat Vulkar as a mastery pickup; players call it a niche, outclassed sniper.
